title: Leadership, Advocacy and Program Planning in the Early Years
description: Focuses on developing students’ knowledge and skills in leadership in the early years sector, including policy engagement, advocacy, supervision, mentorship and the program planning cycle; encompassing needs assessment, stakeholder engagement, and program monitoring and evaluation. Students add to their professional portfolio, including creating a comprehensive program proposal.
notes: Credit will be granted for only one of CYC 482, CYC 480 (if taken Jan-Apr 2020).
Students in the Bachelor of Child and Youth Care program must earn a minimum grade of C+ in all pre- or co-requisites.
